jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Ads Security
jobs.description: The Ads Security organization at Amazon is dedicated to creating innovative technical solutions that detect, assess, and mitigate security risks within Amazon’s Advertising businesses. Our vision is to accelerate the development velocity of the Advertising business by ensuring that our products are inherently secure. We are seeking a seasoned Software Engineer to build software security solutions that will enable our partners in Amazon Ads to deliver at the speed of business, and reduce the time they spend securing their products and applications. This is a rare opportunity to join at the early stage of a critical program which would help us build security innovation and automation solutions, capable of securing systems and resources on a massive scale. You will be expected to contribute to all parts of the software development and deployment lifecycle, including design, development, documentation, testing and operations; as well as have end-to-end ownership of several products in Ads Security. You have proven experience in security, big data, and in implementing solutions leveraging AI. A successful candidate has strong verbal and written communication skills, be self-driven, and deliver high quality results in the face of ambiguity in aa fast paced environment. The ideal candidate will work with high levels of ambiguity, and will help find and resolve problems before we are aware that there will be problems. Amazon teams work with a lot of autonomy, which makes it our challenge to develop solutions to keep them developing securely and with the flexibility that enables them to innovate faster. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Agentic AI
jobs.description: AWS Agentic AI - This role is part of a confidential initiative to build a set of services that will power the next generation of Agentic systems. The work will span across all engineering domains like compute, data bases, networking, identity and will also require partnering with with ML science teams. We aim to hire engineers/managers who will thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative and open environment, who aren't afraid to dive-deep to solve seemingly impossible challenges, who want to build rock solid 24x7 never-fail, highly-secure, software at world-class scale and who obsess over customers. This role is in a new team that is building a new family of AI products. This team is considered strategic and has visibility with AWS leadership at the highest levels. The role offers a chance to build and launch new AI services from the ground up, learn the state of the art in machine learning (ML) technology, and work closely with an exceptional group of product, engineering, and science leaders. Key job responsibilities Design and build highly available control plane APIs, data plane services, and managed agent loops for production AI agents. Deliver secure, isolated execution with tool orchestration, memory, context management, streaming, identity, networking, observability, and failure handling. Design versioning, endpoints, progressive deployment, rollback, evaluations, and optimization capabilities that help customers safely improve agent behavior. Improve latency, scalability, availability, resource efficiency, and cost controls across multi-tenant workloads. Simplify the developer journey across APIs, SDKs, CLI, console, infrastructure as code, and local workflows through cohesive abstractions, templates, defaults, and automation. Work directly with customers to reduce friction, accelerate time to production, and balance beginner-friendly experiences with flexibility for advanced builders. A day in the life As a Software Development Engineer, you will design and build core components across the harness control plane and data plane. You will solve complex distributed systems problems involving agent execution, session state, tool orchestration, security, scalability, reliability, and low-latency streaming. You will help define how developers build and operate agents on AWS and influence the technical direction of a rapidly evolving product area. You will identify the next set of capabilities that can make agent development faster and more accessible. This may include simplifying how customers connect tools and memory, introducing richer agent templates and skills, automating permissions and resource wiring, shortening the build-test-deploy loop, and creating safer ways to evaluate and release changes. This is a rare opportunity to join a newly launched service at an early stage, shape its architecture and customer experience, and deliver capabilities with broad industry impact. Machine learning experience is helpful but not required.
